senses.gloss: m. (v. P. Sm. 408) box-tree or ebony tree [prob. a denom. of אשך = חשך, cmp. גּוּשְׁקְרָא].
units: Neg. II, 1 כא׳ לא שחורים וכ׳ like the eshk’roa, neither black nor white but of an intermediate color.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 89b">B. Bath. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>אשב׳</he> ed. (corr. acc., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30).

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:9">Yoma III, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:8">8</cite>) <he>גורלות של א׳</he> ballot tablets of box-wood (cmp. Sm. Ant. s. v. Buxum); expl. Y. ib. 41ᵃ top <cite ref="Q01361"><he>פסקינין</he></cite> = <he>פוקס׳</he> (πύξινον).
